title: EU IPR — ISO 20022 Structured Address Field Validator
description: Validates EU payment message address fields against the November 2026 ISO 20022 structured address mandate under EU Instant Payments Regulation (EU) 2024/886. Checks pacs.008 AdrLine vs structured TownName/PostCode/StreetName, migration readiness score, and November 2026 countdown. Outputs AP2 compliance mandate.
